3.section: 2.1. SMA model for sorption processes in IEC

7.section: 2.3.1. Introduction to the employed mechanistic model for chromatography
7.description: The column-scale concentration balance combines axial convection and dispersion with film transfer between the column fluid and the particles.
7.quote: the first term on the right hand side describes the convective transport through the column, the second term the dispersive transport and the third term the mass transfer to the particle surface

8.section: 2.3.1. Introduction to the employed mechanistic model for chromatography
8.description: The particle-scale mobile-phase concentration balance combines film transfer from the column fluid with exchange between the mobile and bound phases.
8.quote: The second term of Eq. (8) describes ad- and desorption processes on particle level, i.e. the interaction between mobile and bound phase.
